decision.explanation: The question asks for the director of the film "Turkey Shoot." The original sources distinguish between two films titled *Turkey Shoot*: the 1982 film directed by Brian Trenchard-Smith (D1S1) and the 2014 film directed by Jon Hewitt (D2S1). Both are valid answers depending on which version of the film is referenced. Since the question does not specify a year, both directors are acceptable answers.
